scope: Preserve accepted history across initial Live metadata failure, recover on Node/browser connection and distinguish route loss from revocation

browser.controlled_fault: Replace a held initial session_metadata frame with unavailable, then actually disconnect the Node TCP proxy; delay retried HTTP history until retained content is checked
checks: accepted history remains readable during error and automatic retry
fresh history replaces old baseline without duplicate prompts
offline timers stop and reconnect restores active execution
permission changes, approval allow/deny, child navigation, image decoding/zoom and versioned downloads still pass

build_checks: current served JS bytes on both binaries
access_checks: 401/403/404 and policy_denied/invalid_input clear retained REST history
queued stream fragments cannot repopulate revoked history
